page_title: CRY 1-2 BRE | Crystal Palace v Brentford 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+10' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball in, but Mark Flekken comfortably gathers the ball.
90+10' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+8' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
90+7' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace have a free kick from a promising distance.
90+6' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+6' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

90+5' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
90+4' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded the free kick.
90+3' Mikkel Damsgaard will be replaced by Ben Mee (Brentford).
90+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) tries to find Romain Esse, but he puts too much power on the pass. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Brentford.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' The foul by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

89' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
88' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
86' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

85' 1 - 2 Daniel Munoz is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Romain Esse (Crystal Palace) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the left post to make the score 1:2.
84' Thomas Frank is forced to make a change. Kevin Schade (Brentford) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk.
84' Here comes a substitution. Chris Richards is given a rest as he is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
83' Oliver Glasner has decided to make a change. Romain Esse (Crystal Palace) replaces Will Hughes.
80' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
80' 0 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Mikkel Damsgaard is pounced on by Kevin Schade (Brentford). His close-range header flashes past Dean Henderson and into the right of the goal. 0:2.
79' The free kick is delivered by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
79' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brentford.
77' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
75' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
75' The attendance for today's match is 25066.
74' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.

73' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
72' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Ismaila Sarr and he is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
72' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
71' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
69' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
69' Total attempts – 10:9. The number of shots on goal at present is 4:5.
66' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
66' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Dean Henderson no chance!
66' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
65' Brentford will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
63' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
63' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is going to take the penalty!
61' Tony Harrington blows the whistle, Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Brentford are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
60' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

59' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Dean Henderson stops the ball from going inside the top right corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
59' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

59' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the goal, but Mark Flekken keeps it out.

57' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the right post and ricochet away. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
56' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
55' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Mark Flekken, who makes a comfortable save.
54' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) comes onto the pitch because Christian Norgaard simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
54' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
53' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) tries to find Bryan Mbeumo, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
50' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
49' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Dean Henderson shows his agility and makes a save.
47' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Tony Harrington blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' Kevin Schade (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
44' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

43' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Marc Guehi, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
41' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
40' Mikkel Damsgaard floats over the corner and Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post.
40' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is about to take a corner kick.
39' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sprays a pass out to Yoane Wissa, but he can't beat his man inside the box. Brentford have a corner.
38' Bryan Mbeumo puts Yoane Wissa (Brentford) in the clear, but he completely fluffs his lines from mid-range and sends a shot well wide of the left post.
36' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.

35' A through ball from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) fails to reach Eberechi Eze as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Eberechi Eze could have got into a promising position.
34' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.

31' A neat pass is well received by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
31' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball in, but Mark Flekken comfortably gathers the ball.
30' The total number of attempts is 2:3. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:2.
28' Tony Harrington blows his whistle as Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
27' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
27' The resulting corner from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
25' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
24' Brentford have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
24' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

23' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Dean Henderson pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
23' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

22' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Dean Henderson was alert and the score remains the same.
21' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) plays a long ball to Mikkel Damsgaard, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
20' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is penalised for holding. Tony Harrington signals a set piece.
19' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) and Yoane Wissa attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
13' Bryan Mbeumo pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Christian Norgaard (Brentford) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
13' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vitaly Janelt (Brentford). The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) trips an opposition player and Tony Harrington signals a foul.
9' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner which is cleared.
8' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Crystal Palace earn a corner.

7' A sweet pass finds Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. Mark Flekken is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
6' Kevin Schade (Brentford) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
5' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) tries to find Daniel Munoz with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
4' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace), but the defence gets it clear.
3' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner.
2' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.

1' Good touch by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
1' The first half has just begun.
